title: Match dependency and feature profiles
brief: The historical release table records declared combinations. Resolved dependencies, features, successful compilation and delivery are different evidence levels.

choices.choose_when: The consumer matches the qualified composition
choices.tradeoff: Transfer only the assertions actually executed.
Inspect resolution and compile the relevant composition; absence from the table is not incompatibility.

claims.statement: The retained wiring profile uses tracing-opentelemetry 0.32.0 and OpenTelemetry 0.31.0. Version arithmetic is not a compatibility contract.
The retained locked consumer compiles and exports locally with bridge 0.32.0, API/SDK 0.31.0, tracing 0.1.44 and the recorded features. This does not generalize to uncharacterized combinations.

implementation: Inspect actual resolved packages and duplicate crate versions at the trait boundary.
